description: Shorti(쇼티) for «edit my clips like this» or «내 영상 이렇게 편집하려면?». The person's own clips edited to a hit's clock, with their editing tool. `video_id` or `url`: that hit's own cuts, beats, hook and sound. `format_id`: its plan on its reference hit's clock (anchors, free cuts, captions). Cut where their action or phrase ends nearest the hit's cuts; then shorti_check_link.

detail.description: summary: the compact answer, prompts for a model marked for_model. full: every field in both languages, paged by `cursor`.

family_id.description: The same id, by its older name.

format_id.description: A format: alone, its plan on its reference hit's clock; with a hit, that hit in that format.

lang.description: 'en' answers in Shorti's own English: never translate its Korean.

url.description: The hit, by the post's link.
